sentences.translation: 计划的突然改变

sentences.translation: 用一名监察员或建筑师去监督和检查工程的不同阶段。

sentences.translation: 我们假装自己是在月球上吧。

sentences.translation: 他并没睡着，不过是装睡而已。

sentences.translation: 装作不知情是不负责任的做法。

sentences.translation: 我不可以娶她，装作娶她无妨是不对的。

sentences.translation: 这样一来，损失就可视作为博取将来利润而进行的合法投资。

sentences.sentence: Therefore, it is important to note that individual situations may warrant including additional characters in the list of special characters.
sentences.translation: 因此，要注意可能保证把额外字符包括到特殊字符列表中的个别情况，这一点很重要。

sentences.sentence: Learning incessantly is the surest way to keep pace with the times in the information age and an infallible warrant of success in times of uncertainty.
sentences.translation: 持续的学习是在资讯时代中跟时代并驾齐驱的最稳当的方法，也是在变动的世代中成功的可靠保证。

sentences.sentence: At Dean Miller's suggestion, I have allowed her to give the current student organizers the opportunity to propose a program for next semester that might warrant continuation of this event on campus.
sentences.translation: 根据米勒学监的建议，我允许她给学生机会，让他们给下学期的活动提出一个方案，保证这个活动得以在校园内继续开展。

sentences.sentence: There is only scanty evidence of his involvement.
sentences.translation: 显示他牵涉其中的证据不足。

sentences.sentence: The water is heated using energy from the sun.
sentences.translation: 水是利用太阳能加热的。

sentences.sentence: The problem with nuclear energy is dealing with the waste.
sentences.translation: 核能的问题就是要处理核废料。

sentences.translation: …敬重伟大领导人的较老的政治传统。

sentences.translation: 湖水冻得结结实实。

sentences.translation: 又能踏上坚实的土地感觉真好。

sentences.translation: 宝宝吃固体食物了吗？

sentences.translation: 船上的声呐能够探测出水中的固体物。

sentences.translation: 欧洲富裕的精英阶层

sentences.sentence: If this story must be written, we must have the courage to eliminate all adjectives that tend to excite wonder: they would achieve the opposite effect, of impoverishing the narrative.
sentences.translation: 如果必须要写这篇故事，我们必须要有勇气剔除易于激发我们想入非非的所有形容词：这些词会使叙述贫瘠无力，起到相反的效果。

text:
英语词汇 · SAT · 第 222 单元

forgery
音标：英 /'fɔːdʒ(ə)rɪ/  美 /'fɔrdʒəri/
n. 伪造；伪造罪；伪造物
例句：The painting was a very clever forgery.
这幅画是件很巧妙的赝品。

insinuate
音标：英 /ɪn'sɪnjʊeɪt/  美 /ɪn'sɪnjuet/
v. 暗示；使逐渐而巧妙地取得；使迂回地潜入
例句：What are you trying to insinuate?
你想暗示什么？

clientele
音标：英 /,kliːɒn'tel/  美 /'klaɪən'tɛl/
n. 客户；诉讼委托人
例句：This pub had a mixed clientele.
这家酒吧有混杂的顾客群。

misdeed
音标：英 /mis'did/  美 /,mɪs'did/
n.  罪行， 犯罪
例句：...the alleged financial misdeeds of his government.
...他的政府被指控在财政方面行为不当。

recline
音标：英 /ri'klain/  美 /rɪ'klaɪn/
v.  向后靠， 斜倚
例句：She proceeded to recline on a chaise longue.
她开始斜靠在一个躺椅上。

belligerent
音标：英 /bə'lidʒərənt/  美 /bi'lidʒərənt/
adj.  好战的， 好斗的； 交战国的； 交战的
例句：a belligerent attitude
敌对的态度

supplant
音标：英 /sə'plɑːnt/  美 /sə'plænt/
v.  排挤掉， 代替
例句：Barker was soon supplanted as party leader.
巴克在党内的领导地位很快就被人取代了。

abrupt
音标：英 /ə'brʌpt/  美 /ə'brʌpt/
adj.  突然的， 意外的；  唐突的， 鲁莽的
短语：abrupt change — 突变；陡变
短语：abrupt slope — 陡坡
例句：an abrupt change of plan
计划的突然改变

oversee
音标：英 /ˌəuvə'siː/  美 /'ovɚ'si/
v.  监视； 检查； 视察
例句：Use a surveyor or architect to oversee and inspect the different stages of the work.
用一名监察员或建筑师去监督和检查工程的不同阶段。

spontaneous
音标：英 /spɔn'teiniəs/  美 /spɑn'tenɪəs/
adj.  自发的， 自然产生的
短语：spontaneous combustion — 自燃
短语：spontaneous emission — [电磁学]自发发射
短语：spontaneous abortion — 自然流产；自发性流产
短语：amplified spontaneous emission — 放大自发射；放大式自发射
短语：spontaneous ignition — 自燃
短语：spontaneous polarization — 自发极化；自然极化
短语：spontaneous recovery — 自然回复（恢复）；自然痊愈
短语：spontaneous radiation — 自发辐射
短语：spontaneous magnetization — 自发磁化；自发磁化强度
例句：The crowd gave a spontaneous cheer.
人群自发地欢呼起来。
例句：My spontaneous reaction was to run away.
我的本能反应就是逃跑。

pretend
音标：英 /pri'tend/  美 /prɪ'tɛnd/
v.  假装；  装扮； 骗…说
例句：Let’s pretend we’re on the moon.
我们假装自己是在月球上吧。
例句：He’s not asleep – he’s just pretending.
他并没睡着，不过是装睡而已。
例句：To pretend ignorance of the situation would be irresponsible.
装作不知情是不负责任的做法。
例句：I can’t marry her and to pretend otherwise would be wrong.
我不可以娶她，装作娶她无妨是不对的。

licit
音标：英 /'lisit/  美 /'lɪsɪt/
adj.  合法的， 正当的
例句：She made some money by licit means.
他用正当的手段挣了一些钱。
例句：Losses would then be a licit investment in future profits.
这样一来，损失就可视作为博取将来利润而进行的合法投资。

gloomy
音标：英 /'gluːmi/  美 /'ɡlumi/
adj.  令人沮丧的， 抑郁的； 阴沉的， 阴暗的
例句：The report paints a gloomy picture of the economy.
这篇报告描绘了一幅惨淡的经济现状。

warrant
音标：英 /'wɔrənt/  美 /'wɔrənt/
v.  保证， 担保
n. 正当理由；许可证，委任状
短语：arrest warrant — 逮捕证
短语：search warrant — ［法］搜查证
例句：Therefore, it is important to note that individual situations may warrant including additional characters in the list of special characters.
因此，要注意可能保证把额外字符包括到特殊字符列表中的个别情况，这一点很重要。
例句：Learning incessantly is the surest way to keep pace with the times in the information age and an infallible warrant of success in times of uncertainty.
持续的学习是在资讯时代中跟时代并驾齐驱的最稳当的方法，也是在变动的世代中成功的可靠保证。
例句：At Dean Miller's suggestion, I have allowed her to give the current student organizers the opportunity to propose a program for next semester that might warrant continuation of this event on campus.
根据米勒学监的建议，我允许她给学生机会，让他们给下学期的活动提出一个方案，保证这个活动得以在校园内继续开展。

scanty
音标：英 /'skænti/  美 /'skænti/
adj.  缺乏的， 不足的
例句：There is only scanty evidence of his involvement.
显示他牵涉其中的证据不足。

energy
音标：英 /'enədʒi/  美 /'ɛnɚdʒi/
n.  能量
短语：energy consumption — [化]能量损耗
短语：energy saving — 节能，能源节省
短语：energy conservation — 能量守恒；能源节约
短语：solar energy — 太阳能
短语：new energy — 新能源
短语：high energy — 高能量；高能率
短语：energy efficiency — 能源效率；能量效率
短语：low energy — 低能的；低能量
短语：save energy — 节约能源
短语：renewable energy — 再生能源；可更新能源
短语：electric energy — 电能
短语：potential energy — 势能
短语：energy dissipation — 能量耗散
短语：energy source — 安瑞索思（公司名称）
短语：clean energy — 清洁能源
短语：energy storage — 蓄能；能量储存；储能器
短语：kinetic energy — [物]动能
短语：heat energy — 热能
短语：energy industry — 能源产业，能源工业
短语：activation energy — [物化]活化能
例句：The water is heated using energy from the sun.
水是利用太阳能加热的。
例句：The problem with nuclear energy is dealing with the waste.
核能的问题就是要处理核废料。

deference
音标：英 /'defərəns/  美 /'dɛfərəns/
n.  顺从， 尊重
短语：in deference to — 鉴于；听从
例句：...the older political tradition of deference to great leaders.
…敬重伟大领导人的较老的政治传统。

solid
音标：英 /'sɔlid/  美 /'sɑlɪd/
adj. 固体的；坚硬的
n. 固体
短语：solid foundation — 基础雄厚；实体基础
短语：solid waste — 固体废物，固态废物；固体废料，固体垃圾
短语：solid state — 固态
短语：solid phase — [物]固相
短语：solid wood — 实木；紧密材
短语：solid content — 固体含量；固形物
短语：solid material — 固体材料，固体物料
短语：solid solution — 固溶体
短语：solid surface — 固体表面；实体曲面
短语：high solid — 高固体份
短语：solid particle — 固体微粒；实体颗粒
短语：solid fuel — [化]固体燃料
短语：solid support — 载体
短语：solid food — 固体食物；干粮
短语：solid work — 开切工作
短语：solid ground — 坚实地；固定接地
短语：solid fermentation — 固体发酵
短语：suspended solid — 悬浮固体
短语：solid wall — 实体墙；实心墙；实体岸壁
短语：solid structure — 立体结构
例句：The lake was frozen solid .
湖水冻得结结实实。
例句：It was good to be back on solid ground again.
又能踏上坚实的土地感觉真好。
例句：Is the baby eating solid food (= bread, meat etc ) yet?
宝宝吃固体食物了吗？
例句：The ship’s sonar can detect the presence of solid objects in the water.
船上的声呐能够探测出水中的固体物。

opulent
音标：英 /'ɔpjulənt/  美 /'ɑpjələnt/
adj.  富裕的， 丰富的
例句：Europe’s opulent elite
欧洲富裕的精英阶层

narrative
音标：英 /'nærətiv/  美 /'nærətɪv/
adj. 叙述的；有故事性的
n.  叙述， 记叙文
短语：narrative poem — 叙事诗；叙述诗
短语：narrative therapy — 叙事疗法
例句：If this story must be written, we must have the courage to eliminate all adjectives that tend to excite wonder: they would achieve the opposite effect, of impoverishing the narrative.
如果必须要写这篇故事，我们必须要有勇气剔除易于激发我们想入非非的所有形容词：这些词会使叙述贫瘠无力，起到相反的效果。

Barker was soon supplanted as party leader.

an abrupt change of plan

The crowd gave a spontaneous cheer.

My spontaneous reaction was to run away.

Let’s pretend we’re on the moon.

He’s not asleep – he’s just pretending.

To pretend ignorance of the situation would be irresponsible.

I can’t marry her and to pretend otherwise would be wrong.

She made some money by licit means.

Losses would then be a licit investment in future profits.

The report paints a gloomy picture of the economy.

Therefore, it is important to note that individual situations may warrant including additional characters in the list of special characters.

Learning incessantly is the surest way to keep pace with the times in the information age and an infallible warrant of success in times of uncertainty.

At Dean Miller's suggestion, I have allowed her to give the current student organizers the opportunity to propose a program for next semester that might warrant continuation of this event on campus.

There is only scanty evidence of his involvement.

The water is heated using energy from the sun.

The problem with nuclear energy is dealing with the waste.

...the older political tradition of deference to great leaders.

The lake was frozen solid .

It was good to be back on solid ground again.

Is the baby eating solid food (= bread, meat etc ) yet?

The ship’s sonar can detect the presence of solid objects in the water.

Europe’s opulent elite

If this story must be written, we must have the courage to eliminate all adjectives that tend to excite wonder: they would achieve the opposite effect, of impoverishing the narrative.
